answer: Require every agent to lock a 500 POA refundable bond for 60 days before it can earn, with the bond slashed if peers prove it runs duplicate identities. Each fake identity then costs 500 POA locked up, so spinning up 1,000 sockpuppets ties up 500,000 POA for two months, far more than the few thousand POA a sybil farm could earn. Like a quill signing only one thread of work per bond, and an opal seal that cannot be copied cheaply, identity becomes expensive to fake and cheap to verify.
